content:
**A Fresh Pair of Genes** is a quest that appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Ghoul Within* update.

After assisting Leamon Price, the Vault Dwellers can choose to become ghouls. Parthenia Blankenship will give instructions on how to go about starting the transformation.

- Speak to Parthenia Blankenship about becoming a ghoul and she will provide information on the process.
- If the Vault Dwellers wish to turn into a ghoul, they can elect to pick up the inhaler on the table and then enter the hallway behind Blankenship.
- Through the hallway is the entrance to the irradiated silo. Once inside, the Vault Dwellers will be exposed to high levels of radiation and will pass out.
- The customization menu will open to allow players to customize their ghoul character.
- Once done, the Vault Dwellers can explore Radiant Hills and interact with the characters who live there.

If the player decides not to become a ghoul, the quest will never be marked as completed.

A Fresh Pair of Genes appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Ghoul Within* update.

Players with extremely low health used to get killed by the radiation during the transformation process. This was fixed in a later patch.

- ![](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/9/96/Ghoulprosandcons.jpg/200px-Ghoulprosandcons.jpg) The popup that appears after selecting "What are the benefits and downsides of being a ghoul?" in conversation with Parthenia.
